data.format: prompt = chat template [user], add_generation_prompt, enable_thinking=False, tokenized alone; response = tokenizer(response, add_special_tokens=False) + <|im_end|>
data.labels: -100 on prompt and padding; response tokens and <|im_end|> scored (L114-115)

loss.normalization: sum of token NLL over the 16 microbatches / scored tokens in the effective batch (L115-116)

schedule.decay: cosine to 0 at update 1250; factor(u) = u/38 for u < 38, else 0.5*(1+cos(pi*(u-38)/1212))

precision.weights: fp32 master (bf16 checkpoint cast to fp32)

overhead.theta0_transfer: built on the training device; no per-update transfer

log_fields: update is 1-based (the update just completed); lr is the rate applied in that update; sft_loss = summed token NLL over the 16 microbatches / scored_tokens; grad_norm_preclip is the global norm after unscale_ (and after the L2-SP gradient) and before clipping; loss_scale is the GradScaler scale used for that update's backward; skipped = the scale dropped (inf/nan grads)
